newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada sells 8,000 ounces of gold in August.
newsitem.headline: Canada sells 8,000 ounces of gold in August.

text.p: Canada sold 8,000 ounces of gold in August, bringing reserves to 3.1 million ounces as of August 31, the Finance Department said on Thursday.
The gold was held at a book value of US$0.41 million and added US$2.6 million to the international reserves after deducting the decline in the book value of gold holdings.
The Canadian government has a policy of gradually selling off its gold reserves and replacing them with interest-bearing assets.
